comparison.objective: Load four connector modules into a hinged frame and squeeze the frame shut until it clicks; candidate replaces one motion-control harness connector.
comparison.physical_skill: Both involve connector-component alignment, insertion, retention, and latching; the PR adds repeated module placement and frame closure, while the candidate claims extraction plus cable/seal management.
comparison.success_condition: PR defines module seating, frame click, empty positions, trapped-module failure, clearance, and dwell; candidate provides no part, access, insertion, latch, seal, or damage rubric.
comparison.reason: The tasks may share the same essential insertion-and-latching ability, and the underspecified candidate does not establish that its claimed extraction or seal work is actually tested.
